# name -> 4irl-notifs app_id vectors, read by BOTH the shell function (platform/lib/notifs-app-id.sh, tested in
# platform/registry/test_notifs_app_id.sh) and the Go helper, so the two cannot drift.
# Format: <name> TAB <app_id>, or <name> TAB REFUSED when the name must be rejected. Blank lines and # lines are ignored.
birthdays	apps_birthdays
my-app	apps_my_app
chores	apps_chores
a-b	apps_a_b
a1	apps_a1
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-ab-c	apps_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_ab_c
Birthdays	REFUSED
a	REFUSED
-lead	REFUSED
1lead	REFUSED
my_app	REFUSED
has space	REFUSED
dot.ted	REFUSED
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789	REFUSED
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-ab-cd	REFUSED
